boundary_atlas.mode_statement: Love formula and ordered thresholds apply
the patch shape is stationary because orientation is undefined; the formula reduces to Kelvin-mode frequencies
Omega and every lambda square vanish after the overall vorticity factor
excluded from the bounded ellipse theorem
m=3 has zero frequency; no nonlinear conclusion is asserted

collision_boundary.C284: finite point-vortex relative equilibria, not a distributed constant-vorticity free boundary
collision_boundary.C299: viscously diffusing Lamb-Oseen vorticity, not an inviscid rotating patch
collision_boundary.C368: Polubarinova-Galin Laplacian growth with source or sink, not area-preserving Euler contour transport

finite_evidence_role: exact rational modal and invariant regression plus certified root isolation; analytic monotonicity proves all aspects and modes

model.equation: partial_t omega+u dot grad omega=0, div u=0, curl u=omega on R2
model.mode_convention: boundary Fourier label m is measured relative to the instantaneous ellipse principal axes, and lambda_m is the co-rotating-frame frequency with time dependence exp(-i*lambda_m*t)
model.patch: omega(x,t)=vorticity*indicator of the rotating ellipse E_t

nonclaims: no nonlinear orbital or Lyapunov stability theorem
no finite-amplitude filamentation, fission, or post-instability prediction
no bounded-domain, compressible, viscous, or three-dimensional extension
no arithmetic prime owner or target determinant
no target continuation, zero match, Hilbert-Polya operator, or Route B
no literature-priority claim for the Kirchhoff or Love results

proof_receipts.positive_second_factor: G_m(delta)=m*(1-delta^2)/2-1+delta^m is positive on [0,1) for m>=3 because G_m'=m*delta*(delta^(m-2)-1)<0 and G_m(1)=0
proof_receipts.scaled_root: c_m=m*(1-delta_m) lies in (1,2) and satisfies c_m-c_m^2/(2m)=1+(1-c_m/m)^m
proof_receipts.unique_root: F_m(delta)=m*(1-delta^2)/2-1-delta^m decreases strictly from m/2-1 to -2

references.role: classical owner of the Love modal dispersion relation
modern co-rotating convention and Love-mode formula audit
stratified baroclinic extension used only to delimit the two-dimensional Love-mode scope

theorem_contract.critical_equation: for m>=3, delta_m is the unique root in (0,1) of m*(1-delta^2)/2-1-delta^m=0
theorem_contract.rigid_rotation: E_t is E_0 rotated through Omega*t, Omega=vorticity*a*b/(a+b)^2
theorem_contract.scope: spectral linear mode stability only; no nonlinear stability or post-filamentation theorem
theorem_contract.sharp_wall: delta_3=1/2 and gamma_3=3; for nonzero vorticity all m>=3 oscillate for gamma<3, m=3 is critical at 3, and m=3 grows exponentially for gamma>3
theorem_contract.symmetry_modes: lambda_1^2=Omega^2 and lambda_2^2=0 for every ellipse
theorem_contract.threshold_asymptotic: if c_star=1+W(exp(-1)), then m*(1-delta_m) tends to c_star and gamma_m/m tends to 2/c_star
theorem_contract.threshold_order: delta_m and gamma_m=(1+delta_m)/(1-delta_m) strictly increase with m
